headline: The US Energy Department has awarded $159 million to 12 more projects under the Genesis Mission, its programme to speed up science with AI and supercomputers.
score_reason: Official, fresh and concrete funding decision; results of the projects are not yet shown.
importance_line: Researchers at national laboratories and universities get funding to build AI tools for science, but this is the department's own announcement and the projects have yet to show results.
summary: The US Department of Energy announced 12 Phase II awards worth $159 million under the Genesis Mission, a programme that brings AI, advanced computing and the national laboratories together to speed up scientific discovery, according to its press release as carried by The Quantum Insider. The awards bring the Phase II total to 14 projects, and the department is also issuing six new Phase I awards.
notes: Source is the DOE press release; read as carried by The Quantum Insider (url). The HPCwire copy was unreadable. Overlaps C04-02.
